fullDescription: A refined, technical dark-mode design system with a fintech aesthetic, specifically tailored for high-end audio engineering, technical SaaS, or premium hardware brands. Characterized by a deep navy and amber color palette, sophisticated glassmorphism, and editorial typography. Key features include an asymmetrical hero layout, real-time data visualization charts with SVG line animations, and a high-contrast comparison table. Suitable for industries requiring a blend of luxury and performance metrics, such as audio tech, financial platforms, or performance automotive brands.
prompt:
## Resumo
A premium technical interface featuring high-contrast amber accents on a dark navy background. It utilizes glassmorphism cards, technical 'Space Grotesk' typography for data, and an asymmetrical layout that prioritizes metrics alongside product storytelling.

## Estilo Visual
Create a high-end technical UI with a background of #0a0c10. Use a primary accent color of #f59e0b (Amber) with gradients to #d97706. Typography: Use 'Space Grotesk' for headings (font-weight: 700) and numerical data; use 'Inter' for body copy. Glassmorphism: cards should have background: rgba(20, 23, 29, 0.8), backdrop-filter: blur(12px), and a 1px border of rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05). Animations: Include SVG line drawing effects (dasharray/dashoffset) for charts and smooth scale transitions (scale-105) for interactive buttons. Shadows: Use soft, diffused amber glows for primary buttons (shadow-amber-500/20).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
Fixed top navigation, 80px height. Background: semi-transparent glass (#14171d with 12px blur). Left: Brand logo with a waveform icon in an amber gradient square. Center: 4-5 navigation links (text-sm, font-medium, hover color #f59e0b). Right: Login button and a rounded-full 'Buy Now' button with amber gradient and shadow.

### Asymmetrical Hero Section
Layout: 60/40 split. Left side: Massive headline (text-8xl, leading-0.9, tracking-tighter) using Space Grotesk. Below headline, a horizontal 48px divider line followed by a 20px subheading. Right side: A floating glass card (rounded-32px) containing descriptive text and a 3-column grid of metrics (e.g., Star Rating, Owners, Sessions) with bold values and tiny, 10px uppercase tracking-widest labels. Background: Large 800px diffused amber glow and a product image with mix-blend-screen.

### Performance Metrics Section
Section background: #0d0f14. Header: Left-aligned H2 (text-4xl) with small description; right-aligned toggle buttons (Weekly/Monthly). Content: 2/3 width glass card featuring an SVG line chart with frequency response curves (animated line drawing); 1/3 width glass card featuring a large percentage value (+12.4%) and vertical progress bars for secondary metrics.

### Comparison Table
Full-width table with transparent background. Headers: Large, bold font-display titles. Feature column uses muted text (#94a3b8). The 'Elite' or featured column should have a subtle amber wash (amber-500/5) and a surrounding border to highlight premium value. Rows: 24px padding with 1px white/5% border-b. Include check icons for boolean features and custom 'Select' buttons at the bottom.

### Testimonials Grid
3-column grid of glass cards. Content: 5-star rating in amber, italicized body text, and a footer containing a 40px circular avatar, name with a verified check icon, and a 10px uppercase technical label (e.g., 'VERIFIED OWNER').

### CTA Section
Max-width-5xl container. Background: Large glass card (rounded-40px) with internal glow. Content: Centered H2, max-width-lg description. Form: Horizontal layout with a dark input (bg-white/5) and a wide amber gradient 'Join Now' button. Footer note in 10px uppercase tracking-widest text.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Interactive Frequency Chart — Animated SVG line graph representing audio data.
Implement an SVG viewport with two paths: one amber (#f59e0b) with stroke-width 3 and one slate (#475569) with stroke-width 2. Apply a dash-offset animation to the amber path so it 'draws' on load over 3 seconds. Below the chart, place 5 technical frequency markers (20Hz, 1kHz, etc.) in 10px bold uppercase text.

### Metric Glass Card — Floating data container with integrated metrics.
A container with `background: rgba(20, 23, 29, 0.8)`, `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)`, and `border-radius: 32px`. Must feature a vertical 1px gradient line centered above it to create a 'hanging' visual effect. Bottom section includes a 3-column grid separated from top text by a 1px white/5% border-t.
